# Governance inventory and adoption gaps

**Policy pack:** 1.1.0<br>
**Observed:** 2026-10-10 America/New_York (2026-10-11T01:33:25Z UTC)<br>
**Scope:** all 14 repositories in the maintained repository map; default-branch content and read-only live GitHub metadata.<br>
**Status:** inventory evidence only; no repository adoption or product acceptance is certified.

The full source-linked, machine-readable register is [`governance-register.json`](governance-register.json). It preserves the per-artifact source URL/path, revision, status, proposed owner role, exact gap, desired guidance, issue link, verification method, observation timestamp and out-of-tree evidence snapshot path.

## Snapshot and method

The maintained [repository map](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/7f59d33922a0585205547d490b288b49eed32419/integration/repository-map.json) is `2026-10-10` dated and contains 14 entries (blob `fba32f4ebe98c9c0609bfb0f63b7cc293b07e78e`). Its current source revision is [`getticketstub.com@7f59d339`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/commit/7f59d33922a0585205547d490b288b49eed32419); the central implementation plan is pinned at [`getticketstub.com@7f59d339`](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/getticketstub.com/blob/7f59d33922a0585205547d490b288b49eed32419/docs/planning/implementation-plan.md) (blob `e0df0794452497821673081ec999eb232d712b72`). Every mapped repository was readable, each default-branch tree was complete and untruncated, and no access failures occurred. Content claims are pinned to the listed current default-branch SHA; absence is not claimed for other branches.

The read-only issue and PR snapshots cover **242 issues** (241 open) and **77 pull requests** (15 open) across all repositories. API responses were paginated, and PR records returned through the issues endpoint were excluded from issue counts. The full snapshots remain outside tracked files under `gh01-evidence/repos/<repository>/issues.json,pulls.json,labels.json,releases.json,tags.json,community-profile.json,tree.json`.

### Visibility is date-scoped

Live repository metadata reported **14 public repositories** at the snapshot time. The map says private for 13 entries and public for `getticketstub.com`; current live metadata reports all 14 public. The map records a dated October 10 observation and says it preserves its supplied snapshot. Existing OWNERSHIP pages and [the earlier GH-01 evidence](https://github.com/Jevelopers-neatHack-2026/.github/blob/81ad70f17e96ca8257323721a1c0d97202891e85/docs/architecture/OWNERSHIP.md) likewise describe date-scoped observations. This inventory records the mismatch without treating earlier observations as false. Current `.github` visibility is public, as required for GitHub’s documented organization default community-health files.

### Status meanings and adoption limits

`present` means an artifact or live API record was observed at the cited source; it does not mean it is complete, current, adopted everywhere or enforced. `missing` means not found in the inspected default-branch tree or effective community profile at that revision. `outdated` identifies content contradicted by the live observation. `unknown` means the setting or source could not be read. `not-applicable` is used only when the artifact is outside that repository’s role. File absence is scoped to the inspected default branch.

Repository-map owner roles and issue owner roles are proposed. No named maintainer, assignee, reviewer, security contact or repository adoption confirmation was observed. The evidence separates content from configured controls; the presence of YAML does not show that Actions is enabled, a workflow passed, or branch rules exist.

## Content versus controls

The shared contribution file is content, and the profile response confirms its effective default at this observation. It does not configure or inherit repository settings. For `.github` only, supervisor read-only receipts report: Actions enabled; allowed actions `all`; default workflow token permissions `read`; workflows cannot approve pull requests; SHA pinning is not required; branch `main` has no protection (API 404 “Branch not protected”); rulesets and branch rules are empty; private vulnerability reporting is disabled. The Actions access-policy endpoint returned 422 because `.github` is public and that policy endpoint applies only to internal/private repositories. Other repositories’ settings and workflow runs are **unknown** because they were not queried. The current inventory does not certify configured controls, successful workflows, licenses, CODEOWNERS or repository adoption.

GitHub describes organization `.github` community-health defaults [here](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud%40latest/communities/setting-up-your-project-for-healthy-contributions/creating-a-default-community-health-file). Local community-health files can take precedence. The observed profile responses prove the shared contribution file is effective for all 14 now; physical presence remains separate. This default mechanism does not install AGENTS.md, workflows, labels, LICENSE, CODEOWNERS, branch protection or security-reporting settings.
